suggestions.before: I am a data analyst. I like working with data and finding insights.
suggestions.after:
I'm a data analyst who turns product data into decisions. At Juniper Logistics my delivery-time model changed the promise we show at checkout and cut late deliveries by 18% in two quarters.

Over four years, first at Fernway Travel and now at Juniper, I've designed and analysed 14 A/B tests on the booking flow, found where 40% of mobile bookings dropped off, and replaced nine weekly spreadsheet reports with one Looker dashboard that 60+ city managers use.

The tools I use most: SQL, Python (pandas), BigQuery, dbt, Looker and Tableau, with the statistics to read an experiment properly.

I'm looking for product analyst roles, close to a product team. Message me here.

profile.about:
I'm a data analyst who turns product data into decisions. At Juniper Logistics my delivery-time model changed the promise we show at checkout and cut late deliveries by 18% in two quarters.

Over four years, first at Fernway Travel and now at Juniper, I've designed and analysed 14 A/B tests on the booking flow, found where 40% of mobile bookings dropped off, and replaced nine weekly spreadsheet reports with one Looker dashboard that 60+ city managers use.

The tools I use most: SQL, Python (pandas), BigQuery, dbt, Looker and Tableau, with the statistics to read an experiment properly.

I'm looking for product analyst roles, close to a product team. Message me here.
